question: Do public GEO metadata identify compatible fish fin cell contexts, biological replicates, references and processed-file manifests for the proposed non-generative regulatory analysis?

query.acc: GSE or GSM identifier explicitly enumerated by target/child series

allowed_requests.supplementary_url_policy: record link strings only; never fetch linked files
allowed_requests.redirect_policy: same-origin only; public Jina metadata fallback permitted after challenge, separately logged

predeclared_extraction: exact Series and Sample accession identities
series sample membership and child-series relation
raw metadata fields and response SHA256/bytes/retrieval URL/time
sample organism, tissue/source, characteristics, age/stage/time, explicit replicate labels and assay
supplementary-file and relation links as unfetched manifests
provided cell-label metadata and missing cell-level annotations
identity_policy: Validate SOFT header and geo_accession against requested identifier. Stop expansion on unresolved/mismatched identities and preserve failed receipt. Never infer biological independence from separate GSMs, RNA/ATAC libraries, lane or barcode. Missing metadata stays missing; no guessed donor/stage/cell labels.
comparison_policy: Coverage audit only: no statistical test, biological success threshold, sequencing matrix download, sequence generation or model inference. Cell-level labels and checksums of linked files remain unverified.
failure_policy: No retries beyond one separately logged public metadata fallback; failures remain visible and downstream analysis blocked for unresolved identities.
checklist: audit response hashes/counts and derive gaps
